reason: The cited evidence (E1-E3) confirms HVOF deposition of this alloy, in-flight oxidation effects, and a relationship between spraying distance and oxide/hardness, but provides no data on oxidation resistance of the coating on Zr-alloy or any comparison to an uncoated baseline, leaving the core premise of improved high-temperature oxidation resistance unsupported.
premises: FeNiCoCrMo0.5Al1.3 can be deposited as a coating via HVOF spraying
In-flight oxidation during HVOF spraying alters phase composition and properties
